title: Detect the inverse-form representation that loses noncommuting output information

scientific_scope_status: The acquired analytic obstruction refutes the proposed one-simplex inverse-form characterization of conditional Umegaki order for noncommuting prepared outputs. Invertible normalized pure preparations all have the identity channel's inverse form at every finite complex level, despite losing Umegaki information. A strictly faithful rational continuation has universal candidate coefficient17/18 yet an actual finite input pair violates the purported information comparison.
